titleEn: Number of Sets of K Non-Overlapping Line Segments
title: 大小为 K 的不重叠线段的数目
summary: 在 n 个有序点中选择 k 条不重叠线段，线段至少覆盖两个点且允许只在端点相交，求方案数。
insight: 把每条线段的两个端点依次排列，允许相邻线段共享端点等价于插入 k-1 个可重复间隔；方案数可化为组合数 C(n+k-1,2k)。
pitfalls: 线段可共享端点但内部不能重叠

solutions.title: 帕斯卡组合数
solutions.idea: 用组合公式直接计算线段集合数量。

code.java: class Solution { public int numberOfSets(int n,int k){int mod=1_000_000_007,limit=n+k-1,choose=2*k;long[][] combination=new long[limit+1][choose+1];for(int row=0;row<=limit;row++){combination[row][0]=1;for(int col=1;col<=Math.min(row,choose);col++)combination[row][col]=(combination[row-1][col-1]+combination[row-1][col])%mod;}return (int)combination[limit][choose];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numberOfSets(n:Int,k:Int):Int{val mod=1_000_000_007L;val limit=n+k-1;val choose=2*k;val combination=Array(limit+1){LongArray(choose+1)};for(row in 0..limit){combination[row][0]=1;for(col in 1..minOf(row,choose))combination[row][col]=(combination[row-1][col-1]+combination[row-1][col])%mod};return combination[limit][choose].toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numberOfSets(int n,int k){const long long mod=1000000007;int limit=n+k-1,choose=2*k;vector<vector<long long>> combination(limit+1,vector<long long>(choose+1));for(int row=0;row<=limit;++row){combination[row][0]=1;for(int col=1;col<=min(row,choose);++col)combination[row][col]=(combination[row-1][col-1]+combination[row-1][col])%mod;}return combination[limit][choose];} };
